name: Ōzu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōzu city emblem in blue: a broad ring.
history: Municipal flag of Ōzu, a city in Ehime Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 January 2005.

features.role: Ōzu city emblem — a broad ring
